notes: Mehr News Agency (fa). Route: per-day sitemaps in the Persian calendar. Probes: robots.txt 200 (only 'Disallow: /search', sitemaps named, permissive); /sitemap.xml 404; /sitemap/news/sitemap.xml 200 (Google-News urlset, only ~48h of items); /sitemap/1405/sitemap.xml 200, a sitemapindex whose entries are Jalali days -> /sitemap/1405/MM/DD/sitemap.xml. A daily file (e.g. 1405/07/08) returns 200 with ~900-1000 <url> blocks, each <loc> + <lastmod> (no <news:publication_date> in the daily files, only in /sitemap/news/). Mapped 1405 to Gregorian from the anchor verified on the site: 1405/07/08 == 2026-09-30 (dominant lastmod 2026-09-30 in that file, and the article page JSON-LD datePublished 2026-09-30T20:29:48Z). Window 2026-09-25..2026-10-25 = Jalali 1405/07/03..1405/08/03, so 35 daily files were fetched (window +/- 2 days of buffer), ~1 min total. Listed date = Gregorian day of the Jalali file the article id first appears in; dedupe by /news/<id>. IMPORTANT: <loc> carries raw Persian UTF-8 slugs and those URLs fail in polite_fetch (status 0), so the script writes urllib.parse.quote(loc, safe=':/?&=#%') and the percent-encoded form returns 200. /photo/ entries excluded (short pages). Result: 25415 unique URLs, 31/31 days, 09-30=879, 10-10=815, 10-20=967 (min day 533 on 10-09). Verified myself on 10 randomly sampled articles from the TSV: all 200, page JSON-LD datePublished equal to the listed date (delta 0 on all 10), 3506-12174 characters of text.
